why: Issue #1029's confinement is dropped for masses only: a mass whose far corner crosses the midpoint index is cut by `rotate180` to its first-half rows, a slab one or two cells thick that reads as a thin component or as no shape `runs` draws. With no thin pieces at all the cut slabs are still thin, so the masses-only control sees it too.
